attr.title: Berusky 2
attr.desc: The 3D sequel to Berusky. Guide a team of ladybugs through 3D Sokoban-style puzzle levels: push boxes, blow up walls, break stones with a pickaxe and get every bug to the exit.
attr.inst: Ready to run, no additional files needed. The game data is unpacked on the first launch, which takes a few minutes.
